lots.what_it_is: Persian Kashan room-size carpet, catalogued 420 x 310 cm, wool pile, red field with a navy and cream medallion and spandrels, navy main border. Classic 20th century workshop Kashan design, most likely 1970s to 1990s, not antique. Catalogue says Rohani atelier with an authenticity document; not verified.

Page opened. Kashan 425 x 315 cm, royal blue geometric field, terracotta border, perfect condition, in stock. Different design. Retail asking price.

Page opened. Kashan 434 x 317 cm, red ground, ivory and blue medallion, circa 1925-1950, good condition, original fringes. Closest design match but older. Rate 1.6211 AUD per EUR (frankfurter.app, 2026-09-29). Dealer ask, not a price paid.

lots.working: No SOLD evidence survives, so keep_max_hammer = 0 and flip_max_hammer = 0. For reference only, all-in cost at any hammer = hammer x 1.22. lots.confidence_reason: Design reads as a standard Kashan but there is no signature or label read, size and age unverified, and the evidence is asking prices only.
lots.dropped_entries: Leonard Joel via Invaluable, Bakhtiar gallery carpet 360 x 310 cm, est AUD 1,800-2,600, 11 Jun 2026 (page opened): dropped because it is a Bakhtiar garden-panel carpet, not a Kashan, and the result is hidden behind login, so it is neither same item nor a known price.
lots.key_photo_findings: Photos 1-2: full view, red field, cream and navy lobed medallion with pendants, navy spandrels, navy main border, straight and square with no obvious losses. Photos 3-4 and 6: pile looks full and colours fresh; back (photo 6) shows a reasonably fine, even knot. Photo 5 enlarged: a patch of lime green knotted pile with dark knots in the outer guard at the top edge. It could be a woven signature cartouche (possibly the Rohani signature) or a later reknot in off-colour wool; cannot tell from the photo. No fringe close-up shown.
lots.condition: Appears clean and sound with good pile from the photos. Unexplained lime green patch in the top guard border. Ends and fringes not shown closely.
lots.question_for_armitage: Can you confirm the measured size, and whether the lime green patch on the top edge border (photo 5) is a woven signature or a repair? Please also show the fringes, both ends and the authenticity document, and note any moth, wear or stains.

lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 3 enlarged view shows signature M-McWILLIAMS lower right. Photo 7: Lauraine Diggins Fine Art Pty Ltd, 5 Malakoff Street North Caulfield label, MICHAEL MCWILLIAMS 1956-, Love In A Fish Pond 2005, synthetic polymer on composition board, 46 x 164 cm, 250154. Detailed goldfish among reed stems, typical of his tight realist style. Black moulded frame with a patterned gilt slip. Surface looks clean in the photos; no visible damage, though glare and angle limit the view. No glazing apparent.
lots.condition: Appears good; no visible losses, scratches or flaking in the photos. Frame appears sound. Board and back only partly shown.
lots.question_for_armitage: Can you confirm the condition of the painted surface and frame (any scratches, losses or warping of the board), and whether there are any other labels, receipts or provenance papers on the back besides the Lauraine Diggins label?
